SELECT round(avg(is_denied::INT), 4) AS denial_rate
FROM sem.remit_claims
WHERE is_current_adjudication AND payer_name = 'Humana Medicare Advantage'

SELECT count(*) AS denied_lines
FROM sem.remit_lines
WHERE is_current_adjudication AND line_is_denied AND procedure_code = '83036'

SELECT round(avg(paid_amount), 2) AS avg_paid
FROM sem.remit_claims
WHERE is_current_adjudication AND paid_amount > 0
  AND payer_name = 'Medicare Part B North Carolina'

WITH per_claim AS (
  SELECT claim_key,
         min(submission_date) AS first_submission,
         arg_min(service_date_from, submission_date) AS service_date
  FROM sem.claims
  GROUP BY claim_key
),
primary_class AS (
  SELECT claim_key, arg_min(payer_class, submission_date) AS payer_class
  FROM sem.claims
  WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
  GROUP BY claim_key
)
SELECT p.payer_class,
       count(*) AS claims,
       round(avg(date_diff('day', c.service_date, c.first_submission)), 2) AS avg_lag_days,
       median(date_diff('day', c.service_date, c.first_submission)) AS median_lag_days,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE date_diff('day', c.service_date, c.first_submission) > 90) AS submitted_after_90
FROM per_claim c
JOIN primary_class p USING (claim_key)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT round(avg(is_denied::INT), 4) AS denial_rate
FROM sem.remit_claims
WHERE is_current_adjudication AND payer_name = 'Unitedhealthcare Community Plan Nc'

SELECT payment_month, round(avg(is_denied::INT), 4) AS denial_rate
FROM sem.remit_claims
WHERE is_current_adjudication AND payer_name = 'Unitedhealthcare'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT round(avg(is_denied::INT), 4) AS denial_rate
FROM sem.remit_claims
WHERE is_current_adjudication AND payer_name = 'Unitedhealthcare Medicare Advantage'

SELECT round(sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = 'G0483') / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount), 0), 4) AS share
FROM sem.remit_lines
WHERE is_current_adjudication

SELECT submission_month,
       count(*) AS replacement_claims,
       round(sum(charge_amount), 2) AS billed
FROM sem.claims
WHERE frequency_code = '7'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT round(sum(paid_amount), 2) AS paid
FROM sem.remit_claims
WHERE is_current_adjudication AND payer_name = 'Cigna' AND payment_month = DATE '2026-08-01'

SELECT round(sum(patient_responsibility_amount), 2) AS patient_responsibility
FROM sem.remit_claims
WHERE is_current_adjudication AND payer_name = 'Aetna'

WITH first_sub AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key,
         min(submission_date) AS first_sub,
         arg_min(payer_class, submission_date) AS payer_class
  FROM sem.claims
  WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
paid AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key, payment_date
  FROM sem.remit_claims
  WHERE is_current_adjudication AND paid_amount > 0
)
SELECT f.payer_class,
       count(*) AS paid_claims,
       round(median(date_diff('day', f.first_sub, p.payment_date)), 1) AS median_days,
       round(quantile_cont(date_diff('day', f.first_sub, p.payment_date), 0.9), 1) AS p90_days
FROM paid p
JOIN first_sub f USING (claim_key, payer_key)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT a.carc_code,
       count(DISTINCT a.claim_key || '|' || a.payer_key) AS denied_claim_payers
FROM sem.adjustments a
JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.remit_claim_id = a.remit_claim_id
WHERE a.is_current_adjudication AND r.is_denied AND a.group_code = 'CO' AND a.is_denial_carc
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1
LIMIT 5

SELECT round(avg(is_denied::INT), 4) AS denial_rate
FROM sem.remit_claims
WHERE is_current_adjudication AND payer_class = 'medicaid_mco'

WITH pairs AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key,
         min(payer_class) AS payer_class,
         count(*) AS events,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied) AS current_not_denied
  FROM sem.remit_claims
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT payer_class,
       count(*) AS remitted_pairs,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE events = 1 AND current_not_denied = 1) AS first_pass,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE events = 1 AND current_not_denied = 1) / count(*), 2) AS first_pass_rate_pct
FROM pairs
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT a.carc_code,
       count(DISTINCT a.claim_key || '|' || a.payer_key) AS denied_pairs,
       round(sum(a.adjustment_amount), 2) AS co_amount
FROM sem.adjustments a
JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.remit_claim_id = a.remit_claim_id
WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND r.is_denied
  AND a.group_code = 'CO' AND a.is_denial_carc
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT c.claim_key, cl.procedure_code, c.principal_diagnosis_code
  FROM sem.claim_lines cl
  JOIN sem.claims c ON c.claim_id = cl.claim_id
  WHERE c.is_latest_submission
),
agg AS (
  SELECT procedure_code, principal_diagnosis_code, count(DISTINCT claim_key) AS n
  FROM lines
  WHERE principal_diagnosis_code IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
totals AS (
  SELECT procedure_code, count(DISTINCT claim_key) AS total_claims
  FROM lines
  GROUP BY 1
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT procedure_code, principal_diagnosis_code, n,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY procedure_code ORDER BY n DESC, principal_diagnosis_code) AS rn
  FROM agg
)
SELECT r.procedure_code, r.principal_diagnosis_code, r.n AS claims_with_top_dx, t.total_claims,
       round(100.0 * r.n / t.total_claims, 1) AS share_pct
FROM ranked r
JOIN totals t USING (procedure_code)
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT round(avg(is_denied::INT), 4) AS denial_rate
FROM sem.remit_claims
WHERE is_current_adjudication AND payer_class = 'other'

SELECT count(*) AS denied_lines
FROM sem.remit_lines
WHERE is_current_adjudication AND line_is_denied AND procedure_code = '85652'

SELECT round(avg(is_denied::INT), 4) AS denial_rate
FROM sem.remit_claims
WHERE is_current_adjudication
